propositions: Live children declared `none` must be treated as neutral in drift-scope inheritance, contributing no paths and not poisoning sibling declarations, instead of the current behavior treating empty path lists as undeclared.

Container attestation must implement exact scope precedence: own/cited/inherited dependency paths yield `paths`; otherwise explicit parent `none` yields `none`; otherwise all-live-children-`none` promotes only undeclared parent to `none`; otherwise `unscoped`.
Any live undeclared child must poison child inheritance by preventing all child paths from being inherited and blocking false all-none classification, while closed children are ignored.

Plan-review P9 validation must pass leaves and containers with all live children authenticated, ignore closed children, and advise only live undeclared children with both path declaration and `--none` as remedies.

Cheap resign must preserve the same child-derived signed scope using the immutable relation snapshot without network reads, computing child impact from `initial_generation.relation_snapshot.child_ids`.
